Lång vokal ändrar ord.en: A long vowel can change a word

texto: Recognize Swedish letters and observe pronunciation patterns. **Lång vokal ändrar ord** means «A long vowel can change a word». Read the expression as a unit, identify the main word and use it in a daily situation. If your device has a Swedish voice, listen to the example and repeat it. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
